gender_audit.summary: Across 100,974 records from the public Kaggle diabetes benchmark dataset: Female recall is 91.5% (FPR 8.7%, selection 15.0%) and Male recall is 93.7% (FPR 11.0%, selection 19.0%). Demographic parity difference: 0.0406; equalized odds difference: 0.0228.

age_audit.summary: Performance varies strongly by age band: recall is low for <30 (66.1%, FPR 0.1%) and moderate for 30-44 (78.1%, FPR 3.2%), rising to 90.8% for 45-59 (FPR 12.8%) and 97.3% for 60+ with a high false-positive rate of 27.9% (selection 41.6%). Age demographic parity difference is 0.4094 and equalized odds difference is 0.3128.
age_audit.limitation_note: Limitation: False-negative risk is higher in adults under 45 (<30 recall 66.1%, 30-44 recall 78.1%), while adults 60+ experience a high false-positive rate (27.9%). Symptomatic younger adults must still receive confirmatory blood glucose testing.

disclaimer: Fairness metrics are computed on the public Kaggle diabetes benchmark dataset and represent baseline subgroup parity evaluations. Screening results must be confirmed clinically.
